content:
**Metropolitan cities in South Korea (of which there are 7) and their official symbol flowers**

| Metropolitan city | Symbol flower (official name) | Common name / species |
|-------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------|
| Seoul | **Magnolia** | *Magnolia grandiflora* (magnolia) |
| Busan | **Pulsatilla** | *Pulsatilla koreana* (pulsatilla) |
| Incheon | **Sakura** | *Prunus serrulata* (cherry blossom) |
| Daegu | **Rose** | *Rosa* (rose) |
| Gwangju | **Gerbera** | *Gerbera* (gerbera daisy) |
| Daejeon | **Sage** | *Salvia* (sage) |

> **Note:** South Korea actually has **seven** metropolitan cities – the list above includes six of them. The seventh, **Ulsan**, uses the rose (*Rosa*) as its symbol flower as well.
